description: Reference choreography from the American Eagle shirt TikTok (solo, full body, living room; 11.3 s of content before the TikTok end card). Move boundaries from the wrist/elbow/knee trajectories and motion energy of data/dance/pose/americaneagle_8d820a.npz (see docs/DANCE_MODEL_INTERFACE.md section 4 for the schema).
bpm_estimate_note: Estimated from the pump section (5.1-11.0 s): the 'two double pumps + four alternating raises' phrase repeats every 1.93-1.97 s (wrist-height autocorrelation peak at 1.93 s). Assuming the phrase is 4 beats gives ~123 bpm; it could equally be 61.5 bpm half-time. Not verified against the audio track.

moves.name: Ready pose: standing, hands clasped in front at belly-to-chest height, small fidgets
Hands rise beside the face, palms out, as the body leans to screen-right with the screen-left knee bent and heel raised; hold
Arms drop and stand tall, then both arms shoot up overhead in a goal-post shape while the screen-left knee lifts high; hold on one leg
Arms drop to the hips, then both hands pump up to head height twice, elbows bent
Four quick alternating single-hand raises above the head (screen-left, right, left, right), head bobbing
Both hands pump up to head height twice, elbows bent
Four quick alternating single-hand raises above the head (screen-left, right, left, right), head bobbing
Both hands pump up to head height twice, elbows bent
Four quick alternating single-hand raises above the head (screen-left, right, left, right), then both hands pump up once as the clip ends

notes: Content runs 0-11.33 s (last ok frame 340); frames 341-460 are the TikTok end card with no dancer (ok=False).
Full body is in frame: all 17 joints are visible in essentially every ok frame, so the 'legs' fault can fire on this dance.
'ready' is the count-in: the judge's reference clock starts count_in_s after the first ok learner frame unless set_ref_clock is used.
Mirrored selfie (shirt text reversed): the arm the pose model labels 'left' is on screen right. Move names use screen-relative terms.

Pump section 4.9-11.3 s repeats a ~1.95 s phrase three times: both-arm double pump (both wrists peak together at ~0.47 s spacing), then four alternating single-arm raises about 0.23 s apart starting with the screen-left arm. The clip cuts during the first double pump of a fourth phrase (11.0-11.33 s), folded into alt_raise_3.
The end card search bar appears to read @joseriveras_ (low-res, unverified); clips.json lists the handle as unknown.
